en_us.tile.crane_boxer.name: Conveyor Boxer
en_us.tile.crane_boxer.desc: Loads a configurable amount of stacks into boxes which move along conveyor belts$Right-click with screwdriver to set input side$Shift-click with screwdriver to set the output side$Click twice to set the opposite side
en_us.tile.crane_unboxer.name: Conveyor Unboxer
en_us.tile.crane_unboxer.desc: Receives boxes and extracts their contents$Right-click with screwdriver to set output side$Shift-click with screwdriver to set the input side$Click twice to set the opposite side
